import random

synonyms = {
    "specific": ["particular", "unique", "individual", "tailored", "custom"],
    "emergency": ["contingency", "unexpected", "crisis", "backup"],

    "situation": ["circumstance", "context", "condition", "status"]

def replace_synonyms(text, synonym_dict):
    """Replace words in text with synonyms while preserving meaning."""
    words = text.split()
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if word.lower() in synonym_dict:
            synonym = random.choice(synonym_dict[word.lower()])
            words[i] = synonym
    return " ".join(words)
